# wechat-chat-analysis — reference methods

Source: https://github.com/EMANUELALIU/wechat-chat-analysis/tree/fd59b2d1d11f492acde2963d6d2560aa165ed653

Reviewed: analysis-framework.md, references/analysis-framework.md, dating-playbook.md and README.md. The two framework files overlap; dating-playbook.md is at the repository root in this snapshot, despite older internal links to references/.

The product already had evidence-first dimensions, digital-boundary guidance and date reflection prompts. This update independently writes a two-record consistency checklist, needs-based comparison structure and four-part date recap in 人物核对与多对象比较：证据、需求和约会复盘. Upstream economic stereotypes, fixed personality types, forced scoring, invasive verification and export executables are not adopted. No original implementation code or exporter is shipped, and no personal chats were read.

License evidence: [UPSTREAM-LICENSE-NOTICE.md](UPSTREAM-LICENSE-NOTICE.md). The upstream README declares MIT; the inspected snapshot has no separate LICENSE or copyright notice.

Integration and checks: docs/skills-adoption.md.
